title: Singular Free Boundaries in the Critical Dimension
exact_target: Determine whether the critical dimension $d_*$ for singular free boundaries in the one-phase problem is $5$, $6$, or $7$; describe the singular set in the critical dimension; remove the symmetry assumption from the two-dimensional branch-point regularity result; and find a frequency-function proof that may extend to higher dimensions.
